invariants: The report is read-only: a single SELECT with one statement-wide snapshot (PostgreSQL READ COMMITTED per-statement semantics), no writes, no resubmission, no lifecycle change.
The response is bounded (MAX_PUBLICATIONS=200) and reports the true total plus honest truncation — an uncapped report would answer with a multi-megabyte JSON exactly during the incident it diagnoses.

The endpoint never reads the serialized event column and never deserializes payloads: legacy event types remain diagnosable after their classes disappear (the deliberate avoidance of TargetEventPublication.getEvent()).
Access inherits the application's ADMIN-only /actuator/** rule; the smoke test pins the operator-token read and the missing-authority deny.
doors: GET /actuator/eventpublications (ReadOperation) — the single new operator door
OperatorActuatorSurfaceSmokeIntegrationTest — the ADMIN/actuator security door re-pinned for the new endpoint
No write door exists: the endpoint issues no INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE and no Modulith resubmission call

siblingSearch.family: Operator read surfaces over shared tables with bounded responses
siblingSearch.result: The existing actuator surface (OperatorActuatorSurfaceSmokeIntegrationTest) is the family precedent — every operator door is ADMIN-only and covered by the same smoke test, which this PR extends rather than adding a second harness. No other HTTP endpoint reads event_publication directly: /actuator/modulith exposes the MODULE STRUCTURE only and neither reads the publication registry nor deserializes payloads, and IncompleteEventPublications is a Java API for resubmission, not an HTTP diagnostics door (both stay untouched deliberately). The diagnostics gap this PR closes is the absence of a metadata report that never reads payloads — the new endpoint is that report and rides the same access rule as the family.

findings.scenario: An operator triages a stale-publication incident (marketplace_eventbus_stale accumulates) while the metric alone exposes neither the event type, the listener, nor the attempt count, and Modulith's own eventpublication endpoint would deserialize legacy payloads whose classes may no longer exist
findings.invariant: The operator's stale-publication report is a read-only, bounded, one-snapshot view of event_publication metadata that never deserializes event payloads and never mutates rows; access rides the existing ADMIN-only /actuator/** security rule
findings.note: The diagnostics endpoint, its exposure, and the two regression ITs are implemented and the CI run 43909590876 succeeded on the code-bearing head ad91694790 (event pull_request, PR #841). The D11 evidence contract resolves the run's PR association through the LIVE GitHub Actions API, which now reports the PR's CURRENT head (the receipt-bearing head after the receipt commits), so the run can no longer be recorded as this finding's verification without contradicting the validator — the self-reference paradox the change-records README documents ('tested first, then run evidence recorded'). The finding stays open with its full local evidence; the required CI now running on the receipt-bearing head will gate the merge itself, and a follow-up commit may bind a fresh code-bearing run to close it per the contract's sequencing.
